newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks ease, more corrections expected.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks ease, more corrections expected.

text.p: Stock market trading volumes were maintained by large local investors on Monday with prices for most of the banking sector stocks easing, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index fell 2.02 percent to close at 188.74 on turnover of 39.3 million kroons.
"I think we can expect more slight downward corrections especially in banking stocks during the week but generally shares will be stable around this level," said one trader.
Almost all stocks eased slightly during the day. Hansapank was the most traded to close down 3.25 kroons at 178.75 kroons after turning over 20.3 million kroons.
"The volume was still strong, but was made up of blocks of shares from large investors. Small investors are waiting to see which way the market will go," another dealer said.
Forkespank's volume was down to 7.2 million kroons to close at 142.45 down by 0.80 kroon.

Elsewhere on the market, Savings Bank eased to finish the day at 86.35, 1.90 less than Friday's close with a volume of 4.5 million kroons. Union Bank also lost ground on turnover of 4.3 million kroons to end 1.55 kroons down at 41.10 kroons.
Over-the-counter volumes picked up compared to Friday with a volume of 14.3 million kroons.
Rakvere meat plant was the most traded with 3.8 million kroons but eased 0.40 kroons to close at 14.40 kroons.
"These stocks seem to follow the market, there is no new information to move them, they just go wherever the market goes," said a trader.
Plastics maker Norma gained to close up 0.90 kroons at 56.90 after a trade of 2.4 million kroons.
